items.originalTitle: Who will win this year’s ultimate F1 dream ticket? You decide…
detailZh: 谁将赢得今年终极F1梦想门票？由你决定……
今年喜力F1赛季门票的决赛选手名单已经确定——现在F1粉丝可以选出他们想要追随的人
在数百份大奖赛终极奖品的申请之后，喜力x F1赛季门票已经缩减至六位决赛选手——现在F1粉丝可以投票决定谁将获胜。
这些候选人来自英国、新西兰、新加坡、捷克和美国——他们都已经提出了他们一生中冒险的提案，其中一位将获得免费旅行、住宿以及下赛季每场F1比赛的通行证。
全球的F1粉丝被挑战分享他们对这项运动的热情，并解释为什么他们比任何人都值得获得一个难忘的赛季，体验独特的事件，与粉丝建立联系并亲眼目睹比赛。
这项活动由喜力设计，旨在展示通过共同的运动热情可以形成的联系，证明了‘粉丝拥有更多朋友’的理念。
F1粉丝布兰登·伯格是首位获得金色门票的人，他在本赛季已经将他的一些故事分享给了他社交媒体上的近15万名粉丝。他的旅程现在即将结束——现在是时候选择下一个‘明星’来接替他的位置了。
参赛名单展示了这项运动的全球粉丝基础和比赛的巨大影响力——最后六位都有独特的故事要讲述，都有不同的理由让他们值得那个特别的奖项。
Callum，来自苏格兰，小时候曾在电视前假装自己是迈克尔·舒马赫。他是一位热衷于电影摄影的人，并表示：“我希望能带你看看F1赛季票背后的场景，用电影记录F1的人和地方。”
新西兰人Dale表示，他想要探索每一场比赛背后的“F1世界”，了解独特的人物、文化和粉丝。“我想遇见那些让它变得特别的人，并带大家一起体验这份乐趣，”他说。
住在捷克共和国的Lukas表示，赢得奖品将“终于给我的沙发带来一些宁静”并承诺粉丝，他们可以通过为他选择每个周末要参加的挑战来“成为车队老板”，随着赛季的进行分享结果。
来自英国的India称自己是一个“完全普通的粉丝”，希望明年能变得“非凡”，并要求其他粉丝为每场比赛给她设定有趣的挑战，表示赢得比赛将“将我对F1和环游世界的两个激情结合起来。”
Joy，她的家乡新加坡的比赛在本月早些时候举行，她希望利用这次机会体验“全球F1的激动和体育精神”，并有机会与周围的人“分享同样的热情”。
Jose来自美国，他不仅是赛车迷，还迷上了F1背后的策略、技术和团队合作。他去年参观了他在拉斯维加斯的家乡比赛，并表示：“如果能在2027年每场比赛都去旅行，那将真的是梦想成真。”
前往每个大奖赛的机会为这项运动及其粉丝打开了前所未有的接触途径。当前的票持有者Burgess已经展示了如何在这个赛季充分利用这次经历，并且他曾是挑选候选人名单的评审团成员。
在比赛开始前，他说：“我将关注的重点是F1的热情，因为只有真正的粉丝才能充分利用这次机会。放弃它将会很困难，而且选择下一个人的压力相当大。”
比赛面向25岁及以上的粉丝开放，参赛者被要求说出他们最喜欢的车队和车手，并从F1和喜力提供的选项中选择他们愿意带去未来比赛的选手。
然后随机选取了50名参赛者，邀请他们提交一个90秒的视频，说明为什么他们应该成为下一个票证持有者——现在有六个最终视频可供观看，所以粉丝可以决定谁应该赢得这一终身冒险的机会。

detailEn: Who will win this year’s ultimate F1 dream ticket? You decide…
The shortlist of finalists for this year’s Heineken F1 Season Ticket has been set – now F1 fans can choose who they want to follow
After hundreds of applications for the ultimate prize in grand prix racing, the Heineken x F1 Season Ticket is down to six finalists – and F1 fans can now vote to decide who wins.

The candidates – from the UK, New Zealand, Singapore, Czechia and the USA – have all put their pitches forward for the adventure of a lifetime, which will see one of them get free travel, accommodation and passes for every single F1 race next season.

The competition challenged F1 fans around the world to share their passion for the sport and explain why they, more than anyone, deserve to be gifted an unforgettable season of racing, experiencing unique events, connecting with fans and watching the action first hand.
The initiative was designed by Heineken to showcase the connections that can be formed through a shared passion for the sport, demonstrating that ‘Fans Have More Friends.’

F1 fan Brandon Burgess was the first recipient of the golden ticket and has been posting his stories to almost 150,000 followers on his social channels this season. His journey has now almost run its course – and now it is time to choose the next ‘star’ to take over his mantle.

The list of entries demonstrates the sport’s global fanbase and the massive reach of the competition – and the final six all have a unique story to tell, with a different reason why they deserve that special prize.

Callum, from Scotland, used to pretend to be Michael Schumacher in front of the TV when he was a toddler. He’s a keen film photographer and says: “I’d love to take you behind the scenes of the F1 season ticket and show you the people and places of F1 on film.”

New Zealander, Dale, says he wants to discover the “F1 world” behind every race, exploring the unique people, cultures and fans. “I want to meet the people who make it special and bring everyone along for the ride,” he says.

Lukas, who lives in Czechia, says winning the prize would “finally be some peace for my sofa” and promises fans they can “be the team boss” by choosing challenges for him to take part in each race weekend, sharing the results as the season goes on.

India, from the UK, describes herself as a “completely ordinary fan” looking to make next year “extraordinary” – and also asked other fans to set her fun challenges for each race, saying that winning would “bring together my two passions of F1 and seeing the world.”

Joy, whose home race in Singapore took place earlier this month, wants to use the opportunity to experience “the excitement and sportsmanship” of F1 around the world and to have a chance to “share the same passion” with those around her.

Jose, from the USA, is a fan not just of the racing but also of the strategy, technology and teamwork behind F1. He visited his home race in Las Vegas last year and said: “Travelling to every race in the 2027 would honestly be a dream come true.”

The opportunity to travel to every grand prix opens up unprecedented access to the sport and its fans. The current ticket holder Burgess has shown just how to get the best out of the experience this season and he was on the judging panel that picked the shortlist.

Speaking before the competition began, he said: “The key thing I'll be looking for is the passion for F1, because you have to be a true fan to make the most of this opportunity. It’s going to be hard to give it up and there’s quite a lot of pressure choosing who’s next.”

The competition was open to fans aged 25 or over, with entrants asked to name their favourite team and driver and select who they would take to a future race from a list of options provided by F1 and Heineken.

Fifty entrants were then selected at random and invited to submit a 90-second video on why they should become the next ticket holder – and the final six videos are now available to watch, so fans can determine who should win the adventure of a lifetime.

detailZh: 哈斯车队老板小松英昭在签下第二位学院车手拉斐尔·卡马拉后驳斥了‘法拉利B队’的标签
哈斯车队宣布签下法拉利学院车手拉斐尔·卡马拉，他将参加2027赛季的比赛；卡马拉将和另一位法拉利产品奥利弗·贝尔曼并肩作战；10月23日至25日，在美国奥斯汀举行的美国大奖赛的所有各节练习与排位，将在天空体育F1频道直播
小松英昭否认哈斯车队成为法拉利B队，因为法拉利青训车手拉斐尔·卡马拉将与奥利·贝尔曼一起签约
哈斯车队老板小松英昭驳斥了他们车队已成为‘法拉利B队’的猜测，因为他们确认签下了来自意大利车队学院的第二位车手
哈斯周四宣布，21岁的巴西车手Rafael Camara将在2027年为车队驾驶，并签署了一份多年合同。
Camara将和同是法拉利车手学院（FDA）的产物贝尔曼一起驾驶，预计很快将确认这位英国人将第三次留在哈斯车队。

哈斯车队两位车手都仍然与法拉利车队有联系，并保留着未来为意大利车队驾驶的愿望，这进一步加强了两支车队之间牢固的合作关系，法拉利车队还为哈斯车队提供动力单元和其他重要部件。
当被问及卡马拉的签约是否会改变哈斯车队的形象时，小松回答说：“不，说实话，我们与法拉利的合作让我们能够接触到那些法拉利学院的车手。”
拉斐尔·卡马拉与哈斯车队签订了多年合约，作为奥康的替代者。
所以，奥利·贝尔曼，由于我们与法拉利的合作关系，我们有机会在墨西哥（2024年）测试他。
然后，由于我们有了这种关系，我们有机会在波尔蒂马奥测试拉斐尔。
但这也和当初我们选择奥利一样。法拉利从未向我们施压，'哦，阿亚奥，你能带奥利吗？因为他是一名FDA车手，他需要一个赛车席位，或者你能带拉斐尔吗？因为他即将赢得F2，他真的很需要进入一级方程式？'
“都不是。我们完全是自己选择车手，我自己和（车队老板）Gene 哈斯先生一起选择。”
“所以，是的，他们是FDA车手，他们的职业生涯得到了法拉利的支持，但他们是我们哈斯 F1车队的车手，我们没有义务或压力从法拉利那里带走任何人。”
“所以那个法拉利B队的事情甚至都不值得一提。”
为未来法拉利的一个席位而战？
Komatsu还坚称，他并不担心贝尔曼和Camara为了给法拉利留下深刻印象而可能发生的激烈竞争会变成哈斯的问题。
尽管查尔斯·勒克莱尔今年早些时候与法拉利签订了多年合同延期，但他的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿在F1中还能继续多少年仍是个未知数。
这位七届世界冠军将在一月份满42岁，而他的法拉利合同是否延续到2027赛季结束之后还不明确。
奥利·贝尔曼在驾驶艾尔顿·塞纳1985年的Lotus 97T赛车后，忍不住流下了眼泪，这辆赛车是塞纳首次赢得一级方程式赛车胜利的赛车。
每当法拉利需要一位新车手时，贝尔曼和Camara将是明显的竞争者，这意味着他们在哈斯车队的表现可能会成为他们一级方程式未来的决定性因素。
"一级方程式作为一个整体，是一场巨大的竞争，"Komatsu说。"所以，你的第一个目标是击败你的队友。
"但我认为他们都会非常专注于如何发挥出自己的最佳水平。
"因为，再次强调，体育成绩，击败别人，并不完全在你自己的控制之中。你可能正在发挥出你最好的驾驶水平，但别人可能比你开得更好，在这种情况下，你可能会被击败。"
“但这不是你可以控制的事情。你可以控制的是，从自己、从团队那里榨取最好的东西，绝对的一切。我相信这正是那两个家伙将要专注的事情。”
“那两个家伙，拉法和奥利，他们都非常快。”

detailEn: Haas boss Ayao Komatsu dismisses 'Ferrari B-team' label following signing of second academy driver Rafael Camara

Haas have announced the signing of Ferrari Academy driver Rafael Camara for the 2027 season; Camara is set to drive alongside fellow Ferrari product Oliver Bearman; watch every session of the United States GP in Austin on October 23-25, live on Sky Sports F1
Ayao Komatsu denies Haas are a Ferrari B team after Ferrari junior driver Rafael Camara signs alongside Ollie Bearman.
Haas boss Ayao Komatsu has dismissed the suggestion that his squad have become a "Ferrari B-team" after they confirmed the signing of a second driver from the Italian outfit's academy.
Haas announced on Thursday that 21-year-old Brazilian Rafael Camara will drive for them in 2027 after signing a multi-year contract.
Camara is set to drive alongside fellow Ferrari Driver Academy (FDA) product Oliver Bearman, with confirmation that the Brit will remain with Haas for a third season expected soon.

Haas' pairing of the two drivers, who both remain attached to Ferrari and retain ambitions of driving for the Italian team in future, furthers a strong working relationship between the two squads that also sees Ferrari supply Haas with power units and other significant parts.
Asked whether the signing of Camara could alter perceptions of Haas' identity, Komatsu said: "No, honestly, our collaboration with Ferrari gives us the access to those Ferrari Academy drivers.
Rafael Camara has signed a multi-year deal with Haas as Esteban Ocon's replacement.
"So, Ollie Bearman, because of our relationship with Ferrari, we had a chance to test him in Mexico (in 2024).
"And then because we got this relationship, we had a chance to test Rafa in Portimao.

"But it's the same as when we took Ollie. At no point Ferrari pressurised us, 'oh, Ayao, can you take Ollie because he's an FDA driver, he needs a race seat, or can you take Rafa because he's going to win F2 and he really needs to be in Formula 1?'
"None of that. We choose drivers by ourselves completely, by myself and (team owner) Mr Gene Haas.
"So, yes, they are FDA drivers, their careers have been supported by Ferrari, but they are Haas F1 team drivers and we are under no obligation or pressure to take anyone from Ferrari.
"So that Ferrari B-team thing is just not even a starter."
A battle for a future Ferrari seat?
Komatsu also insists he has no concerns that a potentially intense contest between Bearman and Camara to impress Ferrari could become a problem for Haas.
While Charles Leclerc signed a multi-year contract extension with Ferrari earlier this year, it remains to be seen how many more years his team-mate Lewis Hamilton will continue in F1.
The seven-time world champion will turn 42 in January, while it's unclear whether his Ferrari contract stretches beyond the end of the 2027 season.
Ollie Bearman is reduced to tears after driving Ayrton Senna's 1985 Lotus 97T, the car Senna drove to his first-ever Formula 1 victory.
Whenever Ferrari do require a new driver, Bearman and Camara would be obvious contenders, which means the way things play out for them at Haas could be a decisive factor in their F1 futures.
"Formula 1, as a whole, is a huge competition," Komatsu said. "So, a team-mate is the first person you need to beat.
"But both of them, I think they will be really focused on how to get the best out of themselves.

"Because, again, sporting results, beating somebody else, it's not totally under your control. You could be having your best drive, but somebody else can out-drive you, and in the circumstances, you might get beaten.

"But that's not something you can control. What you can control is to get the best out of yourself, absolutely everything, from your team, from yourself. And I believe that's what both of those guys are going to be focused on.
"And both of those guys, both Rafa and Ollie, they are incredibly quick."

items.originalTitle: The extraordinary figures hinting at Aston Martin's pole potential
detailZh: 随着阿斯顿·马丁与它的F1动力单元合作伙伴本田的关系持续紧张，并且关于合作伙伴关系的未来不可避免地出现猜测，现在是时候看看AMR26-Honda的实际表现远不止于令人沮丧的Q1淘汰。
虽然赛巴朗——两辆赛车首次都晋级到Q2——带来了一线希望，但在新加坡一周后希望破灭，阿隆索认为动力单元的涡轮肯定坏了，因为它的性能太差。本田后来报告称他们看不到任何故障...
这引发了一个问题：如果这辆车有一个有竞争力的动力单元，它会在哪里？这是一辆平庸的赛车，一个罕见的阿德里安·纽维的失败之作，有一个糟糕的引擎？或者是一辆好车，有一个真正糟糕的引擎？
如果我们看看赛车在整个赛季中的表现，在附带的图表中，有两点是清楚的。1) 从巴塞罗那（第七轮）到斯帕（第十轮）赛车竞争力明显下降，因为顶级车队不断增加他们的开发，而AMR26仍然停留在第一场赛事的规格。2) 从赛车唯一的更新，在匈牙利（第十一轮）的明显改进。但那辆更新后的赛车在底盘质量上真正处于什么位置？
我们可以通过查看每个赛道的GPS数据，评估汽车在全油门（即主要在直道）部分所损失的时间来进一步分解表现。由于存在许多混淆因素，这并不是一门精确的科学，但它确实给出了一种相当清晰的量级图景。
以下是一个相当简化的统计数据，但意义重大。将维斯塔潘在雪邦的杆位时间与阿隆索的第12快时间进行比较，尽管阿斯顿·马丁车手在全油门部分让出了2.238秒，但他仍然落后2.090秒。这意味着，如果动力相当，阿隆索本可以在杆位上领先一秒半。
更令人惊讶的是，尽管在新加坡的比赛中阿隆索在Q1阶段就出局，并坚信涡轮坏了，但汽车的弯道性能甚至比在雪邦时更具有竞争力。
但这并不总是那么简单，我们还需要了解在整个比较速度范围内的可比阻力和下压力数据，显然这不是车队会公开的信息——无论是向彼此还是向我们。但自从匈牙利升级以来，阿隆索一直在驾驶一辆他赞誉有加的平衡且稳定的赛车。
但是，从本田那里期望的单元改进的后续效果并未显现。虽然阿隆索在Zandvoort赛道获得第九名积分后的冷却圈中对赛车表示赞赏——"感谢在Silverstone的每一个人。太棒了。一辆驾驶起来很棒的车。"——与ADUO 1本田升级的引入相吻合，但两位车手的反馈是，它失去了之前版本所获得的驾驶性提升。
当我们对阿斯顿·马丁与每个赛道的杆位赛车进行比较时，我们得到以下结果：
未全油门时的圈速差距
Hungaroring：+1.310秒（实际：2.601秒；全油门：1.291秒）
Zandvoort：1.011秒（实际：2.487秒；全油门：1.476秒）
Madrid：1.003秒（实际：3.564秒；全油门：2.561秒）
我们可以从这些数字中推导出另一组统计数据，即每个赛道功率单元限制部分和底盘限制部分之间差距的隐含百分比分配。
这些数字表明，即使在匈牙利升级之后，赛车在弯道和全油门部分仍然在浪费时间，但功率单元构成了差距的主要部分，根据赛道布局变化很大。但在雪邦和新加坡，赛车在弯道上的速度比杆位赛车更快。
尽管在事实上是正确的，但我们应该对上述数字持谨慎态度（阅读小字*）。但它们确实描述了一个基本轮廓，其中弯道性能相当不错，最近甚至非常令人印象深刻。
然而，令人担忧的是，随着底盘性能的稳步提升，动力单元似乎在每次ADUO升级后变得更差。
ADUO 1单元在匈牙利之后的一场比赛中出现在赞德福特，全油门时的劣势增加了几分之一。这可能仅仅是各自赛道布局的问题，但正如回忆的那样，车手的反馈表明动力单元在那里几乎没有或没有整体进步。
通过涡轮增压的修改来解决这些驾驶性问题导致了ADUO 2规格，阿隆索首次在巴库获得。这是赛车在雪邦取得如此鼓舞人心的表现时的动力单元，但新加坡错综复杂的弯道布局触发了一场噩梦，糟糕的油门响应和极端不一致的部署。
如果AMR26能够神奇地获得动力单元的平等，它真的会为了 pole 位置而战吗？不，直到 Sepang 之前，不会。在此之前，数据显示自从它在匈牙利升级以来，它将是一款高 Q2/低 Q3 的赛车。但从 Sepang 开始，很可能会的。即使在新加坡也是一样。
但是，关于这一点，有一个免责声明。因为很可能是本田动力单元独特的架构（MGU-K 位于前方，如纽维所要求的，集中了车辆的质量）夸大了车辆的转弯性能。而且，如果使用更强大、传统配置的梅赛德斯或红牛动力单元，它可能会失去这种转弯优势。
然而，在考虑到许多谨慎的免责声明后，我们可以得到一个量级的概念，即底盘和动力单元之间的差异导致了阿斯顿·马丁的大圈速差距。这个更详细的画面将是车队与本田之间持续讨论的核心，以及关于未来合作可能性的讨论。
*细节：阿斯顿·马丁与 pole 之间的部分差距将是赛道演变的结果，这取决于阿斯顿·马丁参加的任何一节练习与排位赛与 Q3 之间的差异。这种赛道演变会因赛事而异。
如果我们把阿斯顿·马丁的时间与阿斯顿·马丁被淘汰的那场练习赛中最快的时间进行比较，这同样具有误导性，因为快车通常只是做到足够舒适地通过，同时节省轮胎并保留全部动力用于Q3，而慢车则是全力加速。
选择的下压力水平也会扭曲底盘与动力单元之间的对比（即低翼片会使动力单元看起来比实际更好）。
detailEn: As the strains on the relationship between Aston Martin and its Formula 1 power unit partner Honda continue and speculation inevitably questions the future of the partnership, it's a good time to look at how the AMR26-Honda is actually performing beyond just the headline depressing Q1 ejections.

While Sepang - where both cars made it through to Q2 for the first time - offered a ray of hope, it was dashed one week later in Singapore where Alonso felt certain the power unit's turbo must be broken, so poor was its performance. Honda later reported it could see no failure...
It begs the question of just where would this car be if it had a competitive power unit? Is it a mediocre car, a rare Adrian Newey dud, with a poor engine? Or a good car with a truly terrible engine?

If we look at the car's performance through the season in the accompanying graph, two things are very clear. 1) The step-change worsening of the car's competitiveness from Barcelona (round seven) to Spa (round 10) as the top teams piled on their developments while the AMR26 remained still in race one spec. 2) The step-change improvement from the car's sole update, in Hungary (round 11). But where does that updated car truly stack up in the quality of its chassis?

We can break down the performances further by looking at GPS data from each track and assessing how much time the car loses in those sections of track taken at full throttle (ie mainly the straights). It's an inexact science because of the confounding number of skewing factors* but it does give an order of magnitude picture which is quite clear.

The following is quite a reductive stat but a significant one. Comparing Max Verstappen's pole time at Sepang to Fernando Alonso's 12th-fastest time, the Aston Martin driver is 2.090s behind despite having surrendered 2.238s to the Red Bull on the full-throttle parts of the lap. The inference is that with power parity Alonso could've been on pole by a tenth and a half.

What is even more eye-opening is that despite the huge disappointment of Singapore, where Alonso went out in Q1 convinced the turbo was broken, the car's corner performance was even more competitive than at Sepang.

It's never quite that simple and we'd need to know comparable drag and downforce numbers throughout the compared speed range too, obviously not something the teams are going to release - to each other or to us. But since that Hungary upgrade, Alonso has been driving a car with a balance and poise that he has praised.

But the hoped-for follow-up of a power unit improvement from Honda has not manifested. While Alonso's praise of the car on the cooling lap at Zandvoort after getting ninth-place points - "Thanks to everyone at Silverstone. Amazing. A lovely car to drive." - coincided with the introduction of the ADUO 1 Honda upgrade, the feedback from both drivers was that it had lost the driveability gains which had been made with the previous version.
When we do the comparison of the Aston Martin to the pole car at each of the tracks since it got its Hungary aero upgrade, we get the following:
Laptime deficit when not on full throttle
Hungaroring: +1.310s (actual: 2.601s; on full throttle: 1.291s)
Zandvoort: 1.011s (actual: 2.487s; on full throttle: 1.476s)
Monza: 0.237s (actual: 3.364s; on full throttle: 3.127s)
Madrid: 1.003s (actual: 3.564s; on full throttle: 2.561s)
Baku: 2.203s (actual: 4.057s; on full throttle: 1.854s)
Sepang: -0.148s (actual: 2.090s; on full throttle: 2.238s)
Singapore: -0.370s (actual: 2.85s; on full throttle: 3.22s)

We can derive a further set of stats from those numbers, that of an implied percentage split of the deficit between power unit-limited and chassis-limited sections of the lap for each of those tracks.

These numbers suggest the car, even after its Hungary upgrade, was losing time in the corner and the full-throttle sections, but with the power unit forming the dominant part of the deficit, varying wildly according to track layout. But at Sepang and Singapore it was faster through the corners than the pole car.

Although factually correct we should treat the above numbers with caution (read the small print*). But they do describe a basic outline, one in which corner performance is more than respectable, recently even very impressive.
Worryingly though, as the chassis performance has steadily improved, the power unit appears to be worse with each ADUO upgrade.

The ADUO 1 unit came one race after Hungary, at Zandvoort, and the deficit at full throttle increased by a couple of tenths. This may be nothing more than the respective track layouts but, as recalled, the driver feedback suggested little or no overall progress from the power unit there.

Attending to those driveability issues via a turbo modification resulted in the ADUO 2 spec, which Alonso first got in Baku. This was the power unit in the car when it had such an encouraging run at Sepang, but the intricate corner-upon-corner layout of Singapore triggered it into a nightmare of terrible throttle response and wildly inconsistent deployment.

If the AMR26 could magically be given power unit parity, would it really have been fighting for pole? Not until Sepang, no. Until then, the numbers suggest that since its Hungary upgrade it would have been a high Q2/lower Q3 car. But from Sepang, quite possibly yes. Even in Singapore.

But again, there is a disclaimer about that. For it is quite possible that the Honda power unit's unique architecture (with the MGU-K up front, as requested by Newey, centralising the car's mass) has flattered the car's cornering performance. And that with a more powerful, conventionally configured Mercedes or Red Bull power unit, it could possibly lose that cornering advantage.

But while taking on board the many cautious disclaimers, we can get an order-of-magnitude idea of the split between chassis and power unit responsible for the big laptime deficit of the Aston Martin. A much more detailed version of that picture will be at the very heart of ongoing discussions between the team and Honda and about what the future might hold for the partnership.

*The smallprint: Some of the deficit of the Aston Martin to pole will be track evolution between whatever session the Aston Martin goes out in compared to Q3. That track evolution will vary from event to event.

If we compared the Aston Martin times to the fastest of the session in which Aston Martin was eliminated it would be equally misleading as the quick cars are typically just doing enough to comfortably get through while saving tyres and full power for Q3 while the slow cars are flat-out.
The chosen downforce levels will also skew the chassis vs power unit picture (ie low wing would make the power unit look better than it is).

keyPointsEn: The car's competitiveness declined significantly from Barcelona to Spa.
The car's performance improved after a sole update in Hungary.

items.originalTitle: Isack Hadjar on reality of racing alongside "prime of the prime" Max Verstappen
detailZh: 伊萨克·哈德贾谈与"巅峰之巅"的马克斯·维斯塔潘并肩作战的现实
伊萨克·哈德贾已经描述自己与马克斯·维斯塔潘并肩作战是非常幸运的
马克斯·维斯塔潘、红牛车队、伊萨克·哈德贾、红牛车队
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说。关注红牛车队，了解一级方程式新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和比赛分析，来自米尔顿凯恩斯。
红牛一级方程式车手伊萨克·哈德贾认为，能与四届冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘搭档是非常幸运的，他表示自己正处于职业生涯的巅峰时刻面对这位荷兰人。
最近与米尔顿凯恩斯车队续约至2027赛季的哈德贾，被赋予了与维斯塔潘搭档的艰巨任务。
在一级方程式的《超越网格》播客中，这位22岁的年轻人详细描述了与维斯塔潘共享维修区空间的现实。
“我知道我可能正处于一级方程式所能达到的最高水平的巅峰时刻，而他就在我旁边的维修区里，”哈德贾解释道。“所以在我这个年纪，在我的职业生涯早期就能有这样的经历，我非常幸运。因此，仅为此，我就感到非常感激，这真是太棒了。”
他补充说：“但我喜欢挑战。我喜欢进入每一节练习时都知道他将设定一个我需要匹配并超越的基准。这真的很令人兴奋。它改变了我整个职业生涯的一切。”
尽管哈德杰认为他的单圈速度可以与之相媲美，但他承认维斯塔潘在比赛日的执行是无与伦比的。
“我会说这正是我预期的维斯塔潘在赛道上的表现。我对他的实力有一个概念，并且这体现得非常好，”他继续说道。
“我在心中想要在赛道上实现的目标，他都能做到。但你的目标和你实际完成的事情之间总是存在差距。”
有时候总会有那么一点差距，但他一直很稳定。他并没有真正意义上的低谷时刻。他从不犯错。他总是出现在正确的时机，正确的地点。他创造了自己的运气。
比如说在赛道上，你有15个弯道，可能你擅长其中一两个，或者两三个、四五个弯道，你做得非常好。但他能在那里匹配你，然后在其他弯道，他保持同样的水平。
然后在整个圈中，他创造了圈速差距。我不会说我看数据时，就像'我无法复制这个'。这是他做到的频率。这最终造成了巨大的差异。他没有高峰。它是平的。它在那里，但它是平的。这就是他成为如此难以对付的车手的原因。
detailEn: Isack Hadjar on reality of racing alongside "prime of the prime" Max Verstappen
Isack Hadjar has described himself as "very, very lucky" to race alongside Max Verstappen
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

Red Bull Formula 1 driver Isack Hadjar believes he is "very, very lucky" to be partnered with four-time champion Max Verstappen, stating he is facing the Dutchman at the "prime of the prime" of his career.
Hadjar, who recently secured a contract extension to remain at the Milton Keynes outfit through the 2027 season, has been tasked with the notoriously difficult role of driving alongside Verstappen.
Speaking on Formula 1's Beyond The Grid podcast, the 22-year-old detailed the reality of sharing garage space with Verstappen.

"I know I'm probably facing the prime of the prime of the level you can achieve in Formula 1, and he's just next to me in the garage," Hadjar explained. "So to experience this at my age, this early in my career, I'm one very, very lucky guy. So just for that, I'm thankful, and it's great."

He added: "But I love the challenge. I love going into every session knowing that he's going to set a benchmark that I need to match and I need to overcome. It's just exciting. It changes everything I've had my whole career."
While Hadjar feels his single-lap pace compares favourably, he admitted that Verstappen's race-day execution remains unparalleled.
"I would say it's exactly what I expected Max Verstappen to be on the track. I had an idea of how good he was, and it translates really well," he continued.
"What I have in my mind that I want to achieve on track, he does it. But there's always a difference between what you're aiming to do and what you actually deliver.

"There's always a little gap sometimes, but he's constant. He doesn't really have low moments. He makes no mistakes. He's always at the right time, the right place as well. He creates his own luck a bit.

"Let's say on a track, you have like 15 corners and maybe there's one corner you master, or two, three, four, five corners, you do really, really well. But he matches you there and then on the others, he keeps that same level.

"And then over the lap, he makes the lap time difference. I wouldn't say I look at the data and I'm like, 'I can't reproduce this'. It's how often he does it. That makes the big difference at the end. He has no peak. It's flat. It's up there, but it's flat. It's what makes him such a tough driver."

items.originalTitle: Ferrari promotes F2 racer to F1 reserve driver role
detailZh: 法拉利提升F2车手至F1预备车手角色
迪诺·贝加诺维奇将离开F2，专注于与斯库德里亚的F1职责
法拉利将青训车队车手迪诺·贝加诺维奇提升为2027赛季的F1预备车手。
贝加诺维奇在过去七年一直是法拉利车手学院的一员，在此期间他赢得了意大利和瑞典卡丁车锦标赛冠军，并在WSK Euro Series中获得亚军。
在他的年轻车手项目中，贝加诺维奇以单座赛车新手的身份在意大利F4中排名第三，在第二次尝试中赢得了欧洲区域锦标赛冠军，并在他的F3赛季中排名第六。目前，这位DAMS车手在2026年F2积分榜上位列第五——再次作为二年级生——在马德里赛道和巴库连续获胜。
尽管在所有他全职参加的比赛中都赢得了比赛，贝加诺维奇还是被另一位法拉利培养的年轻车手，年轻的拉斐尔·卡马拉超越了。这位巴西人在F2锦标赛中作为新秀领跑，并与哈斯车队签订了2027年的F1合同，在那里他预计将与FDA校友奥利弗·贝尔曼搭档。
因此，贝加诺维奇的青训生涯即将结束，他将在没有F1驾驶机会的情况下加入安东尼奥·吉奥维纳齐，进入法拉利的预备名单。这位22岁的瑞典-波斯尼亚人，在2025年和2026年参加了四次FP1练习，将承担额外的开发任务。
尽管卡马拉和贝加诺维奇离开了F2，但明年F1的卫星系列赛仍将有一位法拉利培养的车手。图库卡·塔帕嫩在本赛季结束前排名第三，得益于在最后两轮中取得的三个领奖台位置——在此之前，他在2026年还没有取得过任何前三名的成绩。
detailEn: Ferrari promotes F2 racer to F1 reserve driver role
Dino Beganovic will leave Formula 2 to focus on his F1 duties with the Scuderia
Ferrari is promoting its junior driver Dino Beganovic to a Formula 1 reserve driver role for the 2027 season.
Beganovic has been a member of the Ferrari Driver Academy for the past seven years, after he won the Italian and Swedish karting championships and took the runner-up spot in the WSK Euro Series.

During his time in the young-driver programme, Beganovic finished third as a single-seater rookie in Italian F4, claimed the Formula Regional European Championship title at his second attempt and finished sixth in both his F3 seasons. The DAMS driver currently lies fifth in the 2026 F2 standings – again as a sophomore – with back-to-back victories in Madring and Baku.

Despite winning races in all competitions he has raced in full-time, Beganovic has been surpassed by another Ferrari protege, the younger Rafael Camara. The Brazilian currently leads the F2 championship as a rookie and signed a 2027 F1 deal with Haas, where he is expected to partner fellow FDA graduate Oliver Bearman.

As a consequence, Beganovic’s junior career is coming to an end without an F1 drive, and he will join Antonio Giovinazzi in Ferrari’s reserve roster. The 22-year-old Swedish-Bosnian, who has taken part in four FP1 sessions with the Scuderia across 2025 and 2026, will have additional development duties.

Despite Camara and Beganovic moving on from F2, there will be a Ferrari protege in F1’s feeder series next year. Tuukka Taponen will graduate from F3 after finishing third this season, courtesy of a remarkable three podiums in the final two rounds – he hadn’t taken a single top-three finish prior to this in 2026.

keyPointsEn: Dino Beganovic will be a Formula 1 reserve driver for the 2027 season
